Commentary.Commentary: That's it from all of us here. Hope you liked our coverage today. Will the visitors make a comeback or will the hosts prevail again? Do join us for the second ODI between the two sides on 6th December at the Manuka Oval, Canberra at 0850 IST to find out. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Man of the Match, Australia skipper Steven Smith donates some of his money to charity. He states that he was lucky, was out lbw at one stage but was happy to make it count by posting a big total. Adds that he was looking to set standard in the field and admits that he got a bit hurt when he caught that blinder. Calls it a pleasing thing to get over the line. Credits Cummins for bowling well with some good pace and control. Admits that Head is a smart player, he too got lucky and made it count. Acknowledges that they need to keep preforming since they have been disappointing in the last few series. He is aware that NZ will come back hard but hopes his team can keep the momentum going and seal the series in the next game. Calls it important to smile, since that is why you play the game. Ends by saying that they are always looking to improve as a team.

New Zealand skipper Kane Williamson says that they bowled poorly in the middle stage. Credits Smith for playing a brilliant knock. Admits that it is tough chasing such a big score. Acknowledges that they were good in patches. Adds that he was happy with the way they responded with the bat in the chase. Credits Guptill for scoring a fantastic hundred and feels that had they lost few wickets less in the middle stage, they could have pushed Australia more. Hopes that they can do better in the next game.

Earlier, Australia were reduced to 92/4 before a superb stand between Smith and Head rescued them. Both of them were gifted lives and they made the opposition pay for it dearly. Smith was dropped on 13 and went on to score a stupendous 164. Trent Boult was the only bowler who posed any threat and New Zealand will rue their missed chances in the field. They are 0-1 behind in the series and will look for a win in Canberra to stay alive in the series.

A spirited performance from the Kiwis with the bat to try and chase down 325 but it always looked 50-60 too many for them and that was in fact the margin of victory for the home side - 68 runs. Australia kept taking wickets at regular intervals despite Martin Guptill going great guns and his threatening 92-run stand with Neesham. Guptill was dropped on 56 and he made the hosts pay with a century but he could not get his team through. Hazlewood was the best bowler taking 3/49 and Marsh, Cummins and Zampa chipped in with a couple each.

FOUR! Guptill special! Hurled on a fuller length on middle, Guptill lofts it up and over the mid on region for a boundary. He holds the bat to show how well he played that one. A boundary to get off the mark for the Kiwi opener.
On a length outside off, Guptill looks to defend but gets an inside edge which goes onto his body and dies down. Lucky there, Martin.
Full outside off, Guptill drives it towards mid off from his crease.
Back of a length outside off, Guptill defends it towards point.
Full outside off, Guptill presses forward and defends it.
KANE WILLIAMSON walks in to bat at Number 3.

OUT! That's been the pattern of the day! Angled outside off on a good length, Latham goes for the dab through the off side. The ball goes off the inside edge onto the stumps. Early strike for Australia and Josh is back and amongst the wickets. He had the line covered but not the length and was also beaten by the pace on that one.
Full outside off, Latham presses forward and defends it to covers. Guptill looks for a single but is sent back in time.
Slanted on a length outside off, no shot offered by Latham.
Full outside off, Latham goes for the drive but fails to put bat to ball. There was some noise there.
Outside off, Latham lets it go through safely.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, Latham lets it go. A wide is signaled.
Fuller on middle, Latham clips it through square leg. Starc comes across from deep fine leg and keeps the ball in play. Two runs taken.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Full outside off, Guptill drives it hard into the ground and towards cover-point. A maiden to begin with for Starc!
Slants it on the pads, Guptill looks to clip it away but fails to make contact. The ball goes off the pads to the keeper.
On a length on middle, Guptill defends it towards mid off off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Guptill drives it towards Finch at cover-point who dives to his left and stops it.
Slants it on the stumps, Guptill fails to clip it away. Mild appeal turned down.
Bowls it on middle, comes in, Guptill gets in line and defends it back down the wicket.
Welcome back for the chase! TOM LATHAM and MARTIN GUPTILL are out to bat for New Zealand. Australia begin with MITCHELL STARC. Here we go...
